stories.title: Barrister’s advice sends Flintshire’s limits on challenging cabinet decisions back to full council
stories.summary: Flintshire councillors will vote next week on whether to keep new limits on their power to challenge cabinet decisions, after a barrister said the safest course was to look at them again. stories.title: North Wales Police is warning about suspicious calls showing their own 0300 330 0101 number
stories.summary: North Wales Police is warning people about suspicious calls from a number showing as its own non-emergency line, 0300 330 0101. The force said it received multiple reports last night from people who had received numerous missed calls from the number. stories.title: North Wales police commissioner seeks views on council tax rise
stories.summary: Andy Dunbobbin has launched a consultation on four options, ranging from 34p to 45p a week per Band D household, to raise North Wales Police's funding.

stories.title: North Wales pays Britain’s highest electricity charges as Flintshire MS calls for cheaper power, not net zero at any price
stories.summary: Households in North Wales pay the highest electricity prices in Great Britain, figures from energy regulator Ofgem show.
